title: The Richelot isogeny graph and paramodular forms of weight 3: Atkin-Lehner signs and certified spectra
summary: The Richelot $(2,2)$-isogeny graph $G_p$ of superspecial abelian surfaces in characteristic $p$ is the genus-2 analogue of the supersingular isogeny graph: its weighted adjacency matrix is a Brandt matrix for a compact inner form of $\mathrm{GSp}_4$, and it commutes with an Atkin-Lehner involution $R(π)$. Refining Ibukiyama's conjectures, we conjecture the automorphic origin and the $R(π)$-sign of every eigenvalue: Eisenstein, Saito-Kurokawa, Yoshida and paramodular eigenvalues, and pairs of type-Va eigensystems that only $R(π)$ separates.
